quote: In March 2022, we acquired SoftBank Vision Fund (AIV M2) L.P.'s (SoftBank) Cruise Class A-1, Class F and Class G Preferred Shares for $2.1 billion and made an additional $1.35 billion investment in Cruise in place of SoftBank.
